answer: Time-locked contribution ledger. Each identity must complete sustained useful work, verified by a rotating peer quorum, before earning a durable cedar seal. The rule: new identities stay non-voting until they accumulate a history that a mirror of the ledger shows cannot be faked cheaply. An attacker must fund real labor across many cycles, and any anchor identity they build is forfeit on detection. Cost per sybil is months of genuine output plus quorum scrutiny.
